title: dryopteris inaequalifolia
intro: Dryopteris inaequalifolia, commonly known as Northern Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is native to North America, and its fronds are typically 2-4 feet long, with lance-shaped pinnae and a distinctive unequal pinnae arrangement. The Northern Lady Fern has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce stress, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
